title: test(spec,lint): cheaper slow-file sweeps and re-measured test budgets
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbJquRbbKg1smQPg49yRES4i)_

Part of #23180. This PR covers the packages/spec and packages/lint rows of refresh PR #25960's per-file list that are still over 10 s or over their declared budget (12 rows, listed below). #23180 stays open for the other packages' rows.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Summary

Tests only. Each row is either made cheaper (three files), or given a budget re-measured from #25960's window, or both. Nothing is deleted, no vitest timeout is raised, and no file moves to a slower or skipped project.

- `packages/lint/src/non-record-object-entry.test.ts`: the junk-value sweeps ran every rule once per assertion. They now run each rule once per distinct fixture and memoize the outcome (findings count, or the thrown message), and every assertion reads that record. 348/348 tests, 2.11 s to 1.00 s locally.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.test.ts`: the compiler-API case built its program with the ES5 default lib (DOM declarations) and every ambient `@types` package. Neither is an input of `app.zod.ts`, so the program now uses `lib.es2022.d.ts` and `types: []`. The guard still reads the full member list off the resolved type. 1.49 s to 1.25 to 1.37 s locally.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.manifest.test.ts`: the #12588 block ran the generator twice on one fixture for two read-only cases. It now runs it once per block (`beforeAll` plus a lazy memo, the same shape as `openapi-self-consistency.test.ts`'s shared run). That is one generator spawn (about 7 s) fewer per run. 136.3 s to 125.1 s locally (shared box).

## Rows covered, with their source lines

Source: refresh workflow run 40275747937, job 121418010419 (the #25960 refresh). Line numbers are that job log's.

| Row | Log line | Slowest CI reading (run) | Declared before | Now |
|:--|--:|:--|--:|:--|
| spec `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.retired-keys.test.ts` | 1339 | 241.05 s (40204927516) | 190 | budget 310 |
| spec `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.manifest.test.ts` | 1340 | 226.64 s (40204927516) | 180 | one spawn fewer, budget 290 |
| spec `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.anchor.test.ts` | 1346 | 144.97 s (40204927516) | 140 | budget 190 |
| spec `src/eager-entry-import.test.ts` | 1394 | 41.61 s (40266979145) | 30 | budget 60 |
| spec `scripts/upgrade-guide-docs.test.ts` | 1408 | 30.07 s (40214410982) | 30 | budget 40 |
| lint `src/lazy-deps.test.ts` | 1442 | 13.91 s (40200279306) | none | budget 20 |
| lint `src/runtime-lazy-deps.test.ts` | 1452 | 13.05 s (40200279306) | none | budget 20 |
| spec `scripts/root-entry-type-nameability.pin.test.ts` | 1453 | 12.92 s (40214410982) | none | budget 20 |
| lint `src/non-record-object-entry.test.ts` | 1456 | 12.49 s (40214410982) | none | cheaper, about half the local time |
| spec `src/ui/app.test.ts` | 1459 | 11.90 s (40204927516) | none | cheaper, budget 20 |
| spec `scripts/pure-schema-construction.test.ts` | 1460 | 11.86 s (40214410982) | none | budget 20 |
| spec `scripts/openapi-self-consistency.test.ts` | 1473 | 10.48 s (40204927516) | none | budget 20 |

The window is the hourly runs 40200279306 to 40272142430. Over the window's executed readings, the declared budgets were exceeded in: retired-keys 6 of 10, manifest 6 of 10, anchor 1 of 10, eager-entry 7 of 8, upgrade-guide 1 of 8.

## Re-measure arithmetic

Every budget follows rulings 6181973363 item 2: the slowest CI reading in the window, x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s. Each header line names its reading and run, and each was parsed with `readTestBudget` from `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`.

- retired-keys: 241.05 x 1.25 = 301.3, so 310
- manifest: 226.64 x 1.25 = 283.3, so 290
- anchor: 144.97 x 1.25 = 181.2, so 190
- eager-entry-import: 41.61 x 1.25 = 52.0, so 60
- upgrade-guide-docs: 30.07 x 1.25 = 37.6, so 40
- lazy-deps: 13.91 x 1.25 = 17.4, so 20
- runtime-lazy-deps: 13.05 x 1.25 = 16.3, so 20
- root-entry-type-nameability.pin: 12.92 x 1.25 = 16.2, so 20
- ui/app: 11.90 x 1.25 = 14.9, so 20
- pure-schema-construction: 11.86 x 1.25 = 14.8, so 20
- openapi-self-consistency: 10.48 x 1.25 = 13.1, so 20

`non-record-object-entry.test.ts` gets no budget. Its local time halved, which puts its CI reading at about 6 s by the window's CI-to-local ratio (12.49 / 2.11). Per c91af8ed, a later CI reading over 10 s would be the measurement a declaration needs.

## Why the bscm, eager-entry and upgrade-guide floors stay

One `build-schemas.ts` spawn costs about 7.3 s on a profile: zod to JSON Schema 3.14 s, module load and script 2.73 s, writes 0.97 s, GC 0.40 s, child_process 0.24 s. Each bscm case is one spawn on its own single-cause fixture. retired-keys and anchor have no two cases on an identical fixture, so no run can be shared. In manifest, the #12588 pair was the one identical-fixture pair inside a block. Sharing across blocks (for example a #16431 control with another block's run) would couple fixtures that each block seeds itself, so it is left out. Batching causes or redesigning the producer is the option seat ruling 6176284384 declined.

eager-entry-import spawns one fresh tsx child per published entry by design, and upgrade-guide-docs spawns the real producer once per mode or usage error it pins (about 0.7 s each). Both are kept and re-declared.

## Measurements

Local runs use the CI shape: `CI=true pnpm exec vitest run --project P --maxWorkers=1` with the agent environment variables unset. They ran on a shared box, so ratios carry more weight than absolutes.

| File | Before | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| lint non-record-object-entry | 2111 ms | 999 ms |
| lint lazy-deps | 2312 ms | 2305 ms |
| lint runtime-lazy-deps | 1952 ms | 2030 ms |
| spec ui/app | 1490 ms | 1250 to 1372 ms |
| spec manifest (bscm) | 136.3 s | 125.1 s |
| spec retired-keys (bscm) | 124.0 s | header only |
| spec anchor (bscm) | 121.6 s | header only |
| spec eager-entry-import | 12.3 s | 12.1 s |
| spec upgrade-guide-docs | 6.7 s | 7.3 s |
| spec pure-schema-construction | 3.2 to 4.2 s | 3.7 s |
| spec openapi-self-consistency | 3.4 s | 3.6 s |
| spec root-entry-type-nameability.pin | 3.14 s | 3.11 s |

## Mutation proof (non-record-object-entry)

The memo must not hide a rule regression. I mutated `recordsOf` in `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` to `return v as AnyRec[]` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then ran both the new file and the BASE copy against the same mutant. Both failed the identical set, 121 of 348. The restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD's (693c48ac1308) and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Header-only files (retired-keys, anchor, eager-entry, upgrade-guide, pure-schema, openapi, root-entry pin, both lazy-deps files) change only their budget comment line.
- The bscm files run in the vitest `repo` project, which CI's Test Core owns. Locally I ran only the manifest file after the change, 18/18 green.
- #23180 remains open. Rows outside packages/spec and packages/lint stay with it.

## Verification

All runs below are on head 1a4422743 (this branch merged with main bbf70614b), unless noted.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 164 files, 7356 tests passed (exit 0).
- The six changed spec `local` files, run together after the merge: 6 files, 169 tests passed (exit 0).
- Before the second merge, on ea742f51b: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (723 files, 21902 tests passed, 1 todo), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`. All exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 84 commands. All 84 exit 0, and `--ran` prints: "84 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". One note: `check:dts-closure` first exited 1. After the merge, `@object-ui/plugin-editor` could not build because main's new `monaco-editor` dependency was not installed yet. After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a rebuild of the two named UI packages, it exited 0 ("231/231 declared declaration file(s) present").
- The bscm files belong to the vitest `repo` project, which CI's Test Core runs. Locally, the manifest file ran after its change, 18/18 passed.
